claimed_scope: Build the smallest deterministic persistence-agnostic Emergent Retrieval planning primitive for Frankenstein 2.0. It consumes exact caller-supplied MemoryLifecycleState metadata plus independently supplied bounded relevance signals (goal, semantic, causal, temporal, state, provenance/confidence) and emits only ranked payload references/provenance with transparent overlap evidence. It must preserve ACTIVE versus DEGRADED status, fail closed on SUPERSEDED memories except an explicit successor reference, require multi-axis support for emergent overlap, use deterministic integer scoring/tie-breaks, never read payload contents, never infer facts/semantics/signal values, never read/write UnifiedDB, never invoke a model/provider/tool, never authorize effects or completion, and never turn retrieval into canonical truth. Source plus deterministic falsification tests and repository-hosted CI only; no VPS, physical GRID10 or whole-system credit.
